import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
ACC={'Homo sapiens':'P08185','Mus musculus':'Q06770','Rattus norvegicus':'P31211','Bos taurus':'E1BF81',
 'Pongo abelii':'Q5R9E3','Sus scrofa':'Q9GK37','Ursus arctos':'B2D1U1','Ovis aries':'P49920',
 'Xenopus laevis':'Q00387','Oryctolagus cuniculus':'P23775','Mesocricetus auratus':'Q60543',
 'Saimiri sciureus':'P50451','Macaca mulatta':'F7F6V9','Callithrix jacchus':'F7IEE1',
 'Equus asinus':'A0A8C4N2N6','Balaenoptera musculus':'A0A8C0C8N1','Castor canadensis':'A0A8B7W9W5',
 'Sarcophilus harrisii':'G3WB15','Vombatus ursinus':'A0A4X2LYM2','Carlito syrichta':'A0A1U7SH32'}
up=lambda a:''.join(requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
def nw(s1,s2,gap=-8,ext=-0.8):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    F[0,1:]=gap+ext*np.arange(m);F[1:,0]=gap+ext*np.arange(n);P[0,1:]=2;P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sc=np.where(np.frombuffer(s2.encode(),np.uint8)==ord(s1[i-1]),3,-1)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(F[i-1,j-1]+sc[j-1],F[i-1,j]+gap,F[i,j-1]+gap);k=int(np.argmax(o));F[i,j]=o[k];P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m;a=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0: a.append((i,j));i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and (j==0 or P[i,j]==1): i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return dict(a[::-1])
HUm=up('P08185')[22:]
POS=[13,14,89,90,91,93,95,369,370,371,368,264,260,19]
rows=[]
for sp,acc in ACC.items():
    s=up(acc); sm=s[22:]
    m=nw(HUm,sm)
    idn=np.mean([HUm[h-1]==sm[o-1] for h,o in m.items()])
    rows.append(dict(species=sp,acc=acc,pct_id=round(100*idn,1),
                     **{f'{HUm[p-1]}{p}':(sm[m[p]-1] if p in m else '-') for p in POS}))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('pct_id',ascending=False)
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print('=== SERPINA6 orthologue residues at the helix-D cluster vs steroid-contact controls ===')
print('(column headers = human residue + mature number; "." = identical to human)\n')
D=T.copy()
for c in D.columns[3:]:
    D[c]=[('.' if v==c[0] else v) for v in D[c]]
print(D.to_string(index=False))
cons={}
for p in POS:
    col=f'{HUm[p-1]}{p}'; vals=[v for v in T[col] if v!='-']
    cons[col]=round(100*vals.count(HUm[p-1])/len(vals),1)
print('\n% of 20 orthologues retaining the human residue:')
print(pd.Series(cons).to_string())
T.to_csv('conservation_helixD_cluster.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
cols=[f'{HUm[p-1]}{p}' for p in POS]
M=np.array([[1 if T.iloc[i][c]==c[0] else (np.nan if T.iloc[i][c]=='-' else 0) for c in cols] for i in range(len(T))],float)
ax.imshow(M,cmap='RdYlGn',vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols)));ax.set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=45,ha='right')
ax.set_yticks(range(len(T)));ax.set_yticklabels(T.species,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(T)):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols): ax.text(j,i,T.iloc[i][c],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7)
for j,c in enumerate(cols):
    ax.text(j,-0.8,{'H13':'cluster','H14':'cluster','H89':'cluster','L93':'cluster','L90':'cluster','H91':'cluster',
                    'A95':'hD','F369':'2nd shell','T370':'2nd shell','W371':'steroid','H368':'steroid',
                    'N264':'steroid','R260':'steroid','S19':'steroid'}.get(c,''),ha='center',fontsize=6,rotation=45)
ax.set_title('Conservation of the CBG helix D cluster (H14/H89/L93) vs direct steroid-contact residues',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
